guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 在 MINDS.GAMES 领取参与席位
guide.description: 打开 MINDS.GAMES，输入邮箱，接受活动规则并点击领取席位（Claim Your Seat）。通过有效期为 1 小时的邮箱链接登录，无需设置密码。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to MINDS.GAMES , enter your email, accept the campaign rules and click “Claim Your Seat.” Login works through a one-hour email link, so there is no password to set.

guide.title: 连接你的钱包
guide.description: 在仪表盘关联 EVM 钱包，可获得 100 积分；进入排行榜或获得允许名单名额也需要关联钱包。原文称唯一的钱包操作是免费签署所有权证明，不涉及手续费、授权或代币使用额度。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Connect an EVM wallet from your dashboard. This earns 100 points and is required to appear on any leaderboard or receive an allowlist place. The only wallet action is a free ownership signature, with no gas, approvals or token allowances.

guide.title: 完善个人资料并关联 X 账号
guide.description: 填写姓名和国家以获得少量奖励，然后关联 X 账号，使自己出现在邀请排行榜上。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Complete Your Profile and Connect X
guide.original_description: Add your name and country for a small bonus, then connect X to appear on the referral leaderboard.

guide.title: 在 HelloMinds 创建或关联 Mind
guide.description: 通过仪表盘中的链接打开 HelloMinds，创建 AI 智能体。如果已有 Mind，将其 HelloMinds 资料中的三项信息复制到仪表盘，即可领取一次性 100 积分奖励。与 Mind 完成 3 次对话可解锁价值 5 美元的 HelloMinds 额度；该额度只能在平台内使用，不是现金或代币。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Create or Link a Mind on HelloMinds
guide.original_description: Open HelloMinds through the link in your dashboard and create your AI agent. If you already have a Mind, copy the three details from its HelloMinds profile into the dashboard to claim the one-time 100-point bonus. Have three conversations with your Mind to unlock $5 in HelloMinds credits These credits work on the platform only and are not cash or a token

guide.title: 完成活动任务和每周精选任务
guide.description: 完成仪表盘中的任务，包括关注 @MindGames_AI 和 @hellominds_。每周精选任务通过审核后，每项奖励 150 积分；请每周查看新任务。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Complete Quests and Featured Weekly Tasks
guide.original_description: Work through the quests on your dashboard, including follows for @MindGames_AI and @hellominds_. Featured weekly tasks pay 150 points each once approved, so check back every week for new ones.

guide.title: 分享你的邀请链接
guide.description: 从仪表盘复制并分享个人邀请链接。新用户注册、连接钱包并关联或创建 Mind 后，邀请才会激活并奖励 250 积分；同时关联 X 账号的被邀请者会计入更多奖励。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Copy your personal referral link from the dashboard and share it. A referral only activates, and pays 250 points, once the new user signs up, connects a wallet and links or creates a Mind. Referees who also connect X count for more.

guide.title: 持有符合资格的 Robinhood NFT（可选）
guide.description: 如果持有符合资格的 Robinhood NFT，请将其保留在已连接的钱包中。1.5 倍积分倍率仅在 NFT 留在该钱包时生效；团队尚未公布符合资格的 NFT 系列名单。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If you own an eligible Robinhood NFT, keep it in your connected wallet. The 1.5x multiplier applies only while the NFT stays there, and the team has not published the list of qualifying collections yet.
